en.title: Suspect Found Dead After Six Victims Shot in Washington Condominium Incident
en.dek: A suspect died after barricading himself and starting a fire during a condo-related shooting that left six victims hit in Washington, D.C.
facts: Six victims have been confirmed in the condominium-related shooting in Washington, D.C.
The suspect barricaded himself inside and started a fire before being found dead.
Initial reports from WJLA stated one person was killed and five others were injured.
The shooting occurred at a gym and condo facility in Washington's Logan Circle neighborhood on 13 November 2026.
body: Police confirmed a sixth victim in a condominium-related shooting in Washington, D.C., on 13 November 2026, after emergency services located the additional individual. Al Jazeera reported that the suspect barricaded himself inside the building and started a fire before officers found him dead at the scene.

The incident unfolded in the Logan Circle neighborhood, where initial reports from WJLA indicated that a gunman shot six people inside a local gym. Axios reported that the attack took place within minutes in the high-traffic commercial and residential area. Emergency responders arrived shortly after the gunfire broke out to secure the surrounding blocks.

First responders treated five injured victims at the scene and transported them to local facilities following the gunfire, according to WJLA. The total count reached six victims as law enforcement officers conducted a full sweep of the damaged building.

Police units closed off streets around Logan Circle while firefighters addressed the flames started by the barricaded suspect. Officials have not publicly named the suspect or disclosed the identities of the victims while the investigation remains active.
en.context: Logan Circle is a dense residential and commercial neighborhood located in Northwest Washington, D.C., known for its high foot traffic and active public venues.

en.dek: A gunman killed one person and wounded five others during a shooting inside a gym in Washington's Logan Circle neighborhood before dying at the scene.
body: A gunman shot six people inside a gym in Washington's Logan Circle neighborhood on 13 November 2026, leaving one person dead and five others injured before the shooter died at the scene. WJLA reported that the attack resulted in one fatality, while Axios reported that the incident unfolded within minutes in the high-traffic area. Authorities confirmed the gunman is dead following the incident.

Five injured victims received treatment after the gunfire broke out inside the facility, according to WJLA. Axios reported that the attack upended one of the busiest neighborhoods in Washington, D.C., as emergency responders arrived at the scene.

Police units secured the area around the Logan Circle facility shortly after the shooting took place. Officials have not yet released the names of the victims or the dead gunman while the investigation continues.
facts: One person was killed in the shooting inside a Logan Circle gym.
Five people were injured during the attack.
The gunman is dead, according to news reports.
The incident took place in Washington, D.C., on 13 November 2026.

de.dek: Ein Schütze tötete eine Person und verwundete fünf weitere bei einem Schusswaffengefecht in einem Fitnessstudio im Stadtteil Logan Circle in Washington, bevor er am Tatort starb.
body: Ein Schütze schoss am 13. November 2026 in einem Fitnessstudio im Stadtteil Logan Circle in Washington sechs Personen und tötete eine Person, während fünf andere verletzt wurden, bevor der Schütze am Tatort starb. WJLA berichtete, dass der Angriff zu einem Todesopfer führte, während Axios berichtete, dass sich der Vorfall innerhalb weniger Minuten in dem stark frequentierten Gebiet ereignete. Die Behörden bestätigten den Tod des Schützen nach dem Vorfall.

Fünf verletzte Opfer erhielten nach dem Schusswaffengefecht in der Einrichtung medizinische Behandlung, so WJLA. Axios berichtete, dass der Angriff einen der belebtesten Stadtteile in Washington, D.C., erschütterte, als Einsatzkräfte am Tatort eintrafen.

Polizeieinheiten sicherten das Gebiet um die Einrichtung in Logan Circle kurz nach dem Schusswaffengefecht ab. Beamte haben die Namen der Opfer oder des toten Schützen noch nicht bekannt gegeben, während die Ermittlungen andauern.
facts: Eine Person wurde bei dem Schusswaffengefecht in einem Fitnessstudio in Logan Circle getötet.
Fünf Personen wurden bei dem Angriff verletzt.
Der Schütze ist laut Nachrichtenberichten tot.
Der Vorfall ereignete sich am 13. November 2026 in Washington, D.C.
